s: Dine habdala al hayyayin ubo y"t seipim: hinhigu chakamim lehariach bibsamim bemotzae shabbat, mittaam sheyyitbaer besimman rtz"z. Vetzarik sheyyebarek qodem hareach. Vehitzriku gam ken lebarek al haur bekol motzae shabbat, mittaam sheyyitbaer besimman rtz"ch. Vesidderu berakot ellu al hakkos achar birkat hayyayin qodem birkat habdala, bitchilla al habbesamim, veachar kak al hanner, venimtza seder habdala sheal hakkos, birkat hayyayin ubirkat habbesamim ubirkat hanner ubirkat habdala, vesimmanak yibbane"h, "yayin "besamim "ner "habdala:
Vetzarik lizzaher bekos shel habdala bekol haddebarim shetztzarik lizzaher bekos shel qiddush veshel birkat hammazon, kemo shennitbaer besimman qp"g vesimman ra"a:
Nahagu lomar qodem habdala shebbabbayit "hinneh el yeshuati vego'", "layyehudim hayeta vego'", "kos yeshuot essa vego'". Hakkol lesimman tob, veen choba baddabar:
Ubishat birkat habdala yittenu hashshomeim et enehem bakkos ubanner:

Venohagin lishpok meat yayin mehakkos al haaretz lesimman tob, shekkol bayit sheen yayin nishpak bo kammayim en bo simman beraka, al ken osin simman beraka bitchillat hashshabua. Veen bazeh issur mishshum bizzuy mashqeh sheshshopeko leibbud, kevan sheeno shopek ella dabar muat. Veyesh linhog shepika zo beshaa shemmemalle hakkos al kol gedotayv, yaareh alayv od meat beinyan sheyyishshapek mimmennu meat al haaretz. Abal en lishpok al haaretz miyyayin shehakkos nitmalle bo, shehare im yishpok mimmennu lo yihyeh hakkos male al kol gedotayv karauy, veim lo yishpok mimmennu kelum ad achar hahabdala kede shebbishat hahabdala yihyeh adayin male al kol gedotayv — hare zeh bizzayon lebirkat "bore peri haggapen", shebberak otah al kos male karauy veqodem sheshshata mimmennu shapak mimmennu laaretz keillu haya bo dabar maus keshebberak alayv, laken en linhog shepika zo ella bederek shennitbaer. Gam nohagin lishpok al hashshulchan min yayin hannishar bakkos achar shetiyyat hammabdil umekabbin bo hanner, kede sheyyehe nireh lakkol shello hudlaq ner zeh ella lemitzva lener shel habdala lebarek alayv (lepikak im mabdil al ner shebbabbayit shello hudlaq bishbil kak — eno tzarik lekabboto). Venohagin lirchotz enehem miyyayin shel shepika zo, mishshum chibbub mitzva:
En tzarik lehatim mikkos shel habdala lehashshomeim kemo shetztzarik bekos shel qiddush, ella hammabdil ragil lishtoto kullo:

En mabdilin al happat apillu en lo yayin velo shear mashqim. Veeno domeh leqiddush shemmeqaddeshin al happat, lepi shehaqqiddush yesh lo inyan lehappat, sheen qiddush ella bimqom seudda, abal habdala en lah inyan kelal lehappat:

Abal mabdilin al kol mashqeh shehu chamar medina chutz min hammayim, ella im ken yesh lo yayin, sheaz en zeh hiddur mitzva im yabdil al shekar o shear mashqim ap al pi shehem chamar medina. Abal im en yayin bebeto ap sheyyeshno etzel chenvani — en tzarik liqnoto. Umikkol maqom, mitzva min hammubchar lehabdil al hayyayin bekol inyan:

Vaapillu im yesh lo kos yayin sheeno male vekos male shekar o shear mashqeh chamar medina — tob yoter lehabdil al hayyayin im eno pagum. Abal im hu pagum, vehu beinyan shei epshar letaqqeno mippegimato al yede netinat meat mayim letoko, kegon shehu mazug bemayim kebar karauy beinyan sheim yosip alayv meat mayim letoko yitqalqel - azay tob yoter lehabdil al mashqeh chamar medina sheeno pagum:

Venohagin bimdinot ellu lehaqel lehabdil bemotzae pesach al hashshekar ap im yesh lo yayin harbeh bebeto, lepi shehashshekar chabib alayv az yoter min hayyayin. Abal mi sheeno chabib alayv kol kak — yesh lo lehabdil al hayyayin. Veap mi shechabib alayv — eno yakol lehabdil alayv ella bemaqom shehu chamar medina, veal derek shennitbaer besimman ar"b. Abal bimqomot shehayyayin gadel sham, shehayyayin hu chamar medina — eno yakol lehabdil al shum mashqeh, ap shehu chabib alayv meod, vegam en yayin nimtza kelal bair, veal derek shennitbaer sham:

Yom tob shechal lihyot bemotzae shabbat shetztzarik leqaddesh ulehabdil al kos echad veen lo yayin — yesh omerim sheyyakol lomar yaqneha"z al happat, sheap sheen mabdilin al happat, mikkol maqom habdala zo tepela leqiddush, vekevan shemmeqaddeshim al happat yekolim gam ken lomar aleha hahabdala aggab haqqiddush. Veyesh omerim sheyyoter tob lomar haqqiddush vehahabdala al kos shel shekar o shear mashqeh shehem chamar medina. Vehamminhag bimdinot ellu kasbara harishona:

Mi sheen lo bemotzae shabbat lechol lo yayin velo shear mashqim chamar medina vei epshar lo limtzo ballayla ad lemachar bayyom — yesh omerim shemmuttar lo leekol miyyad min haddin im hizkir habdala bitpilla, ella shemmiddat chasidut hu shello litom meuma ad sheyyabdil lemachar. Veyesh omerim shemmin haddin asur lo litom meuma im metzappeh shellemachar bayyom yihyeh lo kos lehabdil alayv, abal im eno metzappeh sheyyihyeh lo lemachar bayyom — en mechayyebim oto lehitannot ad hahabdala, lepikak muttar lo leekol ap bemotzae shabbat miyyad. Uleinyan halaka yesh lehachamir kasbara haacharona, ella im ken hu adam challash sheqqasheh lo lehitannot ad sheyyabiu lo kos lemachar — azay yakol lismok al sebara harishona lehaqel bedibre soperim:

Veim en lo ella kos echad vehu rotzeh lisod, veim yabdil al kos zeh veyishteh mimmennu rob rebiit lo yihyeh lo kos lebirkat hammazon, kegon shei epshar lo lehosip mayim bayyayin hannishar lehashlimo lirbiit shello yitqalqel mechamat hammayim, shekkebar hu mazug karauy bemayim mittechilla — hare zeh soed qodem habdala umebarek birkat hammazon al kos zeh, veachar gemar birkat hammazon mebarek alayv "bore peri haggapen" ubirkat habbesamim vehanner vehahabdala, veachar kak shotehu, shemmutab sheyyiddacheh issur haakila qodem habdala mishsheyyebarek birkat hammazon belo kos achar habdala. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheeno metzappeh sheyyihyeh lo lemachar od kos sheyyukal lebarek alayv birkat hammazon, abal im hu metzappeh shellemachar yihyeh lo od kos — asur lo litom kelum qodem sheyyabdil, ella mabdil al kos zeh sheyyesh lo bemotzae shabbat, velo yisod ad sheyyabiu lo kos lemachar lebirkat hammazon, kemo shennitbaer bekos shel habdala lepi sebara haacharona. Abal lepi sebara harishona sheen tzarik lehamtin milleekol ad sheyyabiu lo lemachar kos lehabdala — gam kan lo yihyeh tzarik lehamtin millisod ad lemachar sheyyabiu lo kos lebirkat hammazon, ella yihyeh rashshay lisod miyyad ulebarek belo kos, velaken yisod qodem sheyyabdil al kos zeh sheyyesh lo, kede sheyyebarek birkat hammazon al hakkos, kemo shennitbaer. Vekol zeh lehaomerim shebbirkat hammazon teuna kos kemo qiddush vehabdala, shetztzarik lechazzer achar kos lebirkat hammazon kemo shetztzarik lechazzer achar kol mitzvot shehen middibre soperim shehen choba, kemo shennitbaer besimman qp"b, abal lehaomerim shebbirkat hammazon enah teuna kos betorat choba gemura, ella shemmitzva min hammubchar lebarek birkat hammazon al hakkos — en mitzva zo docha issur teima qodem habdala, ella yabdil bitchilla al kos zeh sheyyesh lo, veachar kak im yirtzeh yokal vibarek birkat hammazon belo kos, veen tzarik lehamtin milleekol ad sheyyabiu lo kos, ap im metzappeh sheyyabiu lo belayla zeh leachar zeman. (Uleinyan maaseh, kevan shello nipseqa halaka lo kehaomerim birkat hammazon teuna kos, velo kehaomerim sheenah teuna kos, laken mi shennoheg leolam kehaomerim shetteuna kos — gam atta yisod qodem habdala, abal im lipamim hu somek al haomerim sheenah teuna kos — gam atta yachush ledibrehem velo yisod qodem habdala):
Mi sheen yado masseget liqnot yayin leqiddush ulehabdala — nitbaer besimman ra"a ezeh mehem qodem. Umi sheen yado masseget liqnot shemen lener chanukka veyayin lehabdala — yitbaer besimman tra"ch:

Nohagim bimdinot ellu lehabdil meummad likbod hammelek sheanu melavvin oto, vederek leviyya meummad. Umikkol maqom, achar gemar hahabdala yesh lo lesheb velishtot hakkos, sheen letalmide chakamim leekol o lishtot meummad:

Kol dabar shemmebarek alayv tzarik leochozo bimino bishat habberaka, kemo shennitbaer besimman r"[v]. Lepikak, bishat birkat "bore peri haggapen" tzarik leechoz hakkos bimino veyihyu habbesamim bismolo, veachar kak tzarik lehachalip hakkos lismolo vehabbesamim limino vibarek al habbesamim, vetob sheyyihyeh hakkos bismolo ad leachar birkat "bore meore haesh", kede sheyyukal lehistakkel betzipporne yemino, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman rch"tz, veachar kak tzarik lehachazir hakkos limino ulebarek alayv birkat hahabdala shennitqena al hakkos:

(Sheliach tzibbur hammabdil bebet hakkeneset, ap shennitkavven latzet yede chobato, veken acherim sheshshameu venitkavvenu latzet yede chobatam — yekolim lachazor ulehabdil bebattehem lehotzi bene betam haqqetannim shello hayu bebet hakkeneset. Abal haggedolim shello hayu bebet hakkeneset, hoil vehem yekolim lehabdil beatzmam — en lemi sheyyatza kebar yede chobato lehabdil lahem, ella yabdilu beatzmam. Abal) mi shennitkavven shello latzet yede chobato behabdala shebbebet hakkeneset, ap hashsheliach tzibbur atzmo shennitkavven shello latzet yede choba behabdalato — tzarik lachazor ulehabdil bebeto. Lepikak, nahagu haolam shekkol echad chozer umabdil bebeto ap im kol bene beto hayu bebet hakkeneset, lepi sheen datam kelal latzet yede chobatam behabdala shebbebet hakkeneset:

Hashshomea habdala, ben bebet hakkeneset ben betok habbayit, venitkavven latzet yede chobato kesheshshama birkat habdala, ap al pi shello haya bedato latzet behabdala zo bishat birkat hayyayin (vaapillu lo shama kelal birkat hayyayin) — en bekak kelum, veyatza yede chobat habdala. (Ella sheeno yakol lishtot yayin al semak birkat hayyayin shebberak hammabdil, kol shello nitkavven bishmiat birkat hayyayin liptor bah hayyayin sheyyishteh hu):

Ledibre haomerim sheiqqar habdala hu min hattora, shenneemar "zakor et yom hashshabbat leqaddesho", zakerehu ben biknisato ben bitziato, kemo shennitbaer besimman ra"a — hare gam hannashim chayyabot behabdala min hattora keshem shechayyabot beqiddush min hattora, mippene shehuqqash "zakor" le"shamor", kemo shennitbaer sham. Vechayyabot gam ken lehabdil bitpilla veal hakkos ketaqqanat chakamim shettiqqenu alehen kemo shettiqqenu al haanashim, hoil vehen chayyabot kemotam min hattora beiqqar habdala. Abal ledibre haomerim shemmitzvat "zakor" enah ella biknisat hashshabbat velo bitziato, veiqqar habdala enah ella middibre soperim — yesh mi sheomer shehannashim peturot mimmenna, kemo shehen peturot mikkol mitzvat aseh shehazzeman gerama, ben shel tora ben shel dibre soperim. Veap shebbekol maaseh shabbat ish veishsha shavin apillu bidbarim sheenam ella middibre soperim, hoil vehen shavin bidbarim shehen min hattora, dehaynu "zakor" ve"shamor" — hishvum chakamim gam bedibrehem shettiqqenu biglal zekirat hashshabbat o shemirato, abal habdala enah inyan lishmirat hashshabbat, ella dabar bipne atzmo hu shettiqqenu chakamim lehabdil ben qodesh lechol, umatzeu lahem semak min hattora, shenneemar "ulehabdil ben haqqodesh uben hachol". Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim shehahabdala hi meinyan zekirat hashshabbat uqedushshato, shemmazkirin hebdel ben qedushshato lechol, ulepikak hannashim chayyabot bahem middibre soperim kemo shechayyabot bekol haddebarim shettiqqenu chakamim biglal qedushshat hashshabbat, lepi shettiqqenu dibrehem keen shel tora, shehannashim chayyabot be"zakor" ve"shamor" min hattora kaanashim. Veken iqqar. Umikkol maqom, yesh lachush lasbara harishona, shello yabdil lenashim mi sheeno tzarik lehabdil bishbil atzmo shekkebar yatza yede chobato, vegam en zekarim acherim gedolim o qetannim shomeim mimmennu ella nashim bilbad, shellepi sebara harishona shehannashim peturot mehabdala — hare zeh mebarek lebattala. Abal hannashim atzman yekolot lehabdil leatzman ap im hem peturot, kemo shehen yekolot lebarek al kol mitzvat aseh shehazzeman gerama shemmeqayyemot, sheenah beraka lebattala, kemo shennitbaer besimman y"z. (Umikkol maqom, en leish latzet yede chobato bishmiat habdala meishsha, kede lachush lasbara harishona, veod mittaam shennitbaer besimman ra"a gabbe qiddush hayyom):
